scene.picture: 0-26.5 s, one continuous diorama on black. A soft elliptical light pool behind a minimal level: two thin dark slabs with bright top edges at mid-frame, a dashed baseline and a thin measuring line with end ticks; a small glowing white figure (disc head, rounded bell body, arm stubs) hops along a dotted parabola and lands one step short, falling. A dark pill tag above names who plays (FRIEND, later YOU); line-art hands hold a grey device below. At 17 s the frame splits down the middle by a 2 px divider: FRIEND left, YOU right, the same failed hop replayed in both halves; under them pill chips: a bright white chip with the useful advice words on the left, a chip with the harsh words that dims to grey on the right.

lines.text: Friend misses this jump. he hands you the controller and asks, what am I doing wrong?
You say you jump too early, wait till the platform comes back.
Then you try it.
Same early jump, same fall.
And out of your mouth comes, man, I suck at this.
Play those misses side by side.
Both landed one shoe short of the same ledge.
He got an instruction and you got an insult.
You spend a month making your first desk.
You put it up for sale.
You can already picture launch day.
The orders just keep coming.
That night, you check your phone one last time.
Zero orders.
First thing you say is.
Who did I think I was?
Now imagine your friend sends you that exact same list.
First thing you'd say.
Wait, is that the only picture?
Dude, unroll it, I want to see the design.
You knew what to tell.
Are you saying it to yourself?
Then press retry.

scenes.picture: 0-26.5 s, one continuous diorama on black. A soft elliptical light pool behind a minimal level: two thin dark slabs with bright top edges at mid-frame, a dashed baseline and a thin measuring line with end ticks; a small glowing white figure (disc head, rounded bell body, arm stubs) hops along a dotted parabola and lands one step short, falling. A dark pill tag above names who plays (FRIEND, later YOU); line-art hands hold a grey device below. At 17 s the frame splits down the middle by a 2 px divider: FRIEND left, YOU right, the same failed hop replayed in both halves; under them pill chips: a bright white chip with the useful advice words on the left, a chip with the harsh words that dims to grey on the right.
0.3 s fade through black from the diorama to the real-life scene.

26.8-31.1 s: the white figure sits at a dark desk at night under a line-art desk lamp, working on a laptop; the camera pushes in from the room to the laptop screen, a dark product-editor UI with a light PUBLISH button that a cursor clicks. Props drawn as dark fills with 2 px pale outlines.

text: You put it up for sale.

scenes.picture: 31.1-39.0 s: a dark pill chip with a mint dot reads EXPECTATION top-left; a tilted dark plate with a faint perspective grid; a glowing mint curve rises from the left like an exponential, small nodes along it, a bold white counter with a small grey unit word riding its tip and counting up to a big round number; then the whole curve turns red from its tip and collapses down to the floor.
39.0-41.6 s: the plate tilts and turns into a dark device screen lying flat, then stands up: a huge thin-outlined numeral zero with a small uppercase unit word under it, a small header above.

text: And the first thing you say is,

text: "Man. Who did I think I was?"
